name: dth-sc

scripts.review:anchors: bun run folio-assistant-core/scripts/review-anchors-from-folio.ts --document dth-sc --library 9789240101197-eng --source who-iris/uploads/9789240101197-eng/9789240101197-eng.pdf --source-label "the WHO handbook (2024, ISBN 9789240101197) it was seeded from"
scripts.check:review-anchors: bun run folio-assistant-core/scripts/review-anchors-from-folio.ts --document dth-sc --library 9789240101197-eng --source who-iris/uploads/9789240101197-eng/9789240101197-eng.pdf --source-label "the WHO handbook (2024, ISBN 9789240101197) it was seeded from" --check

_workspaces_comment: The mounted code layers, as workspaces, as smart-ra and folio-assistant list them: they import each other by package name (@litlfred/cat-harness-tools, ...), and nothing publishes those packages, so a mount resolves them only through the ONE root node_modules that bunfig.toml's hoisted linker lays out. Without this, fhir-harness's scripts could not find @litlfred/cat-harness-tools and check:review-anchors, site:document and the CI publish failed (dth-hrh#41).
